lore.item.aether_charges.frost_charge: A shard of ambrosium wrapped in icestone. It bursts into a patch of cold, and the Sun Spirit hates it: hit it and the thing freezes as if its own ice crystal struck it.
lore.item.aether_charges.blaze_charge: A core ground from hellfire stone. Throw it and the landing spot burns for a good while.
lore.item.aether_charges.thunder_charge: A bolt of lightning that never fell, sealed in angelic stone. It falls where the charge lands.
lore.item.aether_charges.cloud_charge: Packed aercloud. It does not hurt much; it simply pushes whatever it hits along its path, the way a Zephyr pushes travellers off the islands.
lore.item.aether_charges.frost_scepter: Found deep in the bronze dungeon. No ammunition, only patience: it throws another ice crystal once it has recovered.
lore.item.aether_charges.blaze_scepter: A treasure of the gold dungeon. The fire crystal is the Sun Spirit's own trick; with this in hand it is yours too.
lore.item.aether_charges.thunder_scepter: Silver dungeon loot, once the Valkyrie Queen's. In her hands the thunder was a punishment; in yours it is a tool.
lore.item.aether_charges.cloud_scepter: Another bronze dungeon find. A flick of the wrist sends a cloud out to shove things aside.
